verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs explicitly state approval of a contract is a mandatory gate before any agent touches the repository ('Nothing runs until a person approves a contract... an agent is about to change your repository'), and agents only claim 'approved tasks' from the repo. This directly matches the engineering-lead approval-gate story, reinforced by mobile approval flow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the gate is enforced in practice (not just documented) and detail on what 'scope and contract' specifically contains.
